Summary: EPIC-OPT: Algorithmic Student Budget Protein Optimizer
Description:
Theme: Cost-constrained deterministic nutrition optimization.

Goal: Allow broke college students to input their daily budget (₹40–₹200/day) and algorithmically generate the highest-protein combination of affordable Indian staples within hostel cooking limits.

Key Capabilities: Knapsack linear budget solver, living reality filters (Hostel kettle / Mess survival / Zero-cook), custom Kirana price overrides, and Protein Price Radar.

Summary: EPIC-PLAN: 7-Day Day-Wise Diet Planner & Bulk Campus Procurement
Description:
Theme: Practical, varied day-by-day hostel meal execution and raw ingredient procurement.

Goal: Provide a structured, day-by-day (Monday to Sunday) recipe schedule with daily variety (Moong/Besan Chilla, Egg Bhurji, Paneer Bhurji, Soya Pulao, Chicken Curry, Tawa Fish) so students avoid dietary fatigue and can buy ingredients in bulk.

Key Capabilities: Interactive Monday–Sunday timeline tabs, Veg/Egg/Non-Veg preference switcher, 1-click bulk 7-day grocery list with raw weights, daily pocket money tracker, and +50 XP meal logging.

Summary: EPIC-GENZ: Gen-Z Gamification, Campus Social Squads & AI Fitness Buddy
Description:
Theme: Student habit retention, peer motivation, and conversational AI guidance.

Goal: Keep students motivated through gamified levels, consistency streaks, private campus hostel squads, monthly shareable recaps, and an AI buddy answering dorm cooking and mess survival questions.

Key Capabilities: Leveling from Iron Cadet to Campus Beast, privacy-first squad leaderboards, Broke but Building emergency solver, conversational AI buddy, and Spotify-style Fitness Wrapped recap cards.

Summary: US-01: 5-Step Student Onboarding & Target Engine
Description:
User Story:
As an Indian college student starting my fitness journey,
I want a 5-step onboarding wizard calculating my BMR, TDEE, and daily protein targets based on my biometrics and budget,
So that I have a scientifically tailored plan without hiring an expensive coach.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN a new or guest student user on `#/onboarding`
- WHEN they input age, height, weight, activity level, and daily budget (₹)
- THEN the system computes deterministic BMR using Mifflin-St Jeor and WHO activity multipliers, saves profile, displays Day 1 baseline targets (starting protein at 0g consumed), and awards +150 Onboarding XP.

Summary: US-02: Heuristic Knapsack Budget Protein Solver
Description:
User Story:
As a broke college hosteler,
I want to input my exact daily pocket money (e.g., ₹60, ₹80, ₹100, ₹120) and have the system algorithmically assemble the maximum protein combination,
So that I never waste money on low-protein junk food.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN a target budget and dietary preference
- WHEN the student triggers the optimizer via POST /api/optimizer/solve
- THEN a constrained greedy knapsack algorithm returns a feasible food allocation, itemizing total cost, total protein (g), leftover change, and efficiency metrics.

Summary: US-03: Real-Time Student Living Reality Filters
Description:
User Story:
As a hosteler without a kitchen,
I want to toggle between 'Hostel Mode' (kettle only), 'Mess Survival', and 'Zero-Cook',
So that the optimizer only recommends foods I can actually prepare in my dorm room.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the food optimizer and meal views
- WHEN the student selects 'Zero-Cook' or 'Hostel Mode'
- THEN foods requiring induction/gas stoves or refrigeration are filtered out, leaving kettle-friendly foods like soya chunks, sattu, roasted peanuts, and bananas.

Summary: US-07: Protein Price Radar (₹ per 10g Protein Index)
Description:
User Story:
As a smart student shopper,
I want to view a real-time price radar ranking all Indian staples by cost per 10 grams of protein,
So that I know which grocery items provide the highest nutritional ROI.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the #/radar view
- WHEN the page loads
- THEN a sorted bar graph and price table render staples from lowest cost/10g protein (Soya Chunks at ₹4.5/10g, Sattu at ₹7.5/10g) to expensive commercial proteins, highlighting 'Campus Value Kings'.

Summary: US-08: Interactive 7-Day Day-Wise Schedule Navigation
Description:
User Story:
As a fitness-focused student,
I want to navigate my meal plan day-by-day (Monday to Sunday) with distinct recipes and day themes,
So that I don’t get bored eating the same static meal every day.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the Diet Plans view (`#/meals`)
- WHEN the student clicks on pill buttons [Mon], [Tue], [Wed], [Thu], [Fri], [Sat], [Sun]
- THEN the timeline immediately updates that day's specific meal cards (Breakfast, Lunch, Snack, Dinner), planned cost, macros, and preparation protocol with zero page refresh.

Summary: US-09: Multi-Dietary Preference Switcher (Veg / Egg / Non-Veg)
Description:
User Story:
As an eggetarian or vegetarian lifter,
I want to switch my dietary preference on the fly,
So that all 7 days immediately populate with compliant Indian recipes (e.g., Egg Bhurji & Masala Omelette vs. Moong Chilla & Paneer Bhurji).

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the meal plan controls bar
- WHEN the user clicks '🌱 Veg', '🥚 Egg', or '🍗 Non-Veg'
- THEN the schedule re-renders with certified diet-compliant meals and updates the user profile state.

Summary: US-11: Daily Real-Time Macro & Pocket Money Tracker Dashboard
Description:
User Story:
As a busy student,
I want to see a live visual dashboard of my planned vs. consumed protein, calories, and remaining pocket money for today,
So that I know exactly where I stand at any moment.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the student opens `#/dashboard`
- WHEN the dashboard loads
- THEN animated counters display today's consumed protein (starting at 0% for new onboardings), budget spent, budget remaining, and meal checklist.

Summary: US-12: Single-Tap Meal Consumption Logging with XP
Description:
User Story:
As a student eating a scheduled meal,
I want to click 'Mark Eaten',
So that my daily consumed protein increases and I earn Anabolic XP toward leveling up.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN any meal card in `#/meals` or `#/dashboard`
- WHEN the student taps 'Mark Eaten (+50 XP)'
- THEN POST /api/meals/log records the meal, the button updates to 'Logged ✓', a success toast appears, and the user's total XP increases by +50.

Summary: US-13: Hostel Kettle & Desk Cooking Preparation Protocols
Description:
User Story:
As a hosteler cooking in a dorm room,
I want clear 2-sentence micro-recipes detailing exact preparation steps (under 10 minutes),
So that I can cook without elaborate kitchen equipment.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN any meal card on the timeline
- WHEN viewed by the student
- THEN it presents prep time (e.g., '8 mins'), cooking method ('kettle_or_stove'), and actionable hostel instructions (e.g., 'Boil soya chunks in electric kettle for 4 mins, squeeze out excess water, toss with chaat masala').

Summary: US-15: Student XP Leveling, Anabolic Cadet Ranks & Consistency Streaks
Description:
User Story:
As a student building daily discipline,
I want to accumulate XP and climb fitness ranks (from Level 1: Iron Cadet up to Campus Beast),
So that maintaining my diet feels like an engaging video game.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN a logged-in or guest student session
- WHEN they log meals (+50 XP) or complete daily consistency check-ins
- THEN their streak counter increments, their level progress bar advances, and milestone level-up toasts trigger.

Summary: US-04: Campus Kirana Custom Price Override Tool
Description:
User Story:
As a student whose campus canteen charges different prices than national averages (e.g., ₹7/egg instead of ₹6),
I want to override food unit prices,
So that my optimized budget matches my local Kirana reality.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN any food card in the optimizer directory
- WHEN the user edits the unit price and clicks 'Update Price'
- THEN POST /api/optimizer/price-override persists the custom rate in food_price_overrides and recalculates the knapsack allocation with the updated price.

Summary: US-05: Smart High-Protein Substitutions Engine
Description:
User Story:
As a student who dislikes certain foods (or when an item is out of stock at the campus store),
I want to click a 'Swap' button on any allocated food,
So that I can see comparable protein alternatives within the same price band.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN a solved meal item (e.g., Soya Chunks 50g)
- WHEN the student clicks the swap button (POST /api/optimizer/substitute)
- THEN the modal surfaces at least 3 smart swaps (e.g., Roasted Bhuna Chana or Sattu) that fit within ±₹5 and maintain protein within 15%.

Summary: US-06: The '₹50 Broke Student Challenge' Solver
Description:
User Story:
As a student at month-end with almost zero funds,
I want a 1-click solver that maximizes protein strictly under ₹50/day,
So that I maintain muscle even during severe financial crunches.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the optimizer view
- WHEN the student taps '₹50 Broke Challenge'
- THEN GET /api/optimizer/50-rupee-challenge returns an ultra-lean staple combo (Sattu drink + Soya chunks + Peanuts) delivering over 65g protein for under ₹48.

Summary: US-10: One-Click 7-Day Bulk Grocery Haul Generator
Description:
User Story:
As a hosteler who visits the market once a week,
I want to click 'Generate 7-Day Grocery List',
So that I receive an aggregated raw shopping list with total quantities (e.g., 500g Sattu, 14 Eggs, 350g Oats) and bulk buying hacks.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the Diet Plans view
- WHEN the student clicks 'Generate 7-Day Grocery List'
- THEN a modal opens displaying aggregated weekly spend, average daily cost, bulk shopping items with shelf-life tags, and campus procurement tips (e.g., buying a 30-egg tray to save ₹2/egg).

Summary: US-14: Budget-Saving Ingredient Swaps on Meal Cards
Description:
User Story:
As a student looking to save extra pocket money,
I want each meal card to feature a 'Budget-Saving Swap' tip,
So that I know how to trim costs if my funds run low before month-end.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN any active day's meal cards
- WHEN the card renders
- THEN a dedicated green-bordered tip box suggests a practical money-saving swap (e.g., 'Swap 100g paneer for 60g soya chunks to save ₹28 while gaining +6g protein').

Summary: US-16: Privacy-First Campus & Hostel Squad Leaderboards
Description:
User Story:
As a hosteler lifting with floor-mates,
I want to join or create a private college squad with an invite code,
So that we can compete on consistency streaks and XP without revealing sensitive biometric weights.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the `#/squad` view
- WHEN a user creates a squad or enters an invite code
- THEN they join the squad leaderboard; rankings show XP and streak days only, completely anonymizing body weight and personal medical notes.

Summary: US-17: 'Broke but Building' Emergency Solver
Description:
User Story:
As a student with random loose change in my pocket (e.g., ₹15 or ₹25),
I want to enter that exact amount and instantly receive the highest-protein street or canteen snack available,
So that I don't buy junk chips.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the `#/broke-building` interactive tool
- WHEN the student enters an amount between ₹10 and ₹50
- THEN POST /api/genz/broke-building returns street-smart combos (e.g., ₹15 = 2 Boiled Eggs with black pepper or 40g roasted bhuna chana).

Summary: US-18: Conversational AI Fitness Buddy (Campus & Hostel Engine)
Description:
User Story:
As a confused college lifter,
I want to chat with an AI buddy in natural student lingo,
So that I can ask questions about kettle cooking, mess food survival, and cheap protein on campus.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the `#/assistant` chat view
- WHEN the user sends a query (e.g., 'How to get 30g protein for ₹20 in my room?')
- THEN POST /api/ai/chat responds with structured, realistic advice citing verified Indian staples, with zero hallucination.

Summary: US-19: Spotify-Style 'Fitness Wrapped' Monthly Recap Card
Description:
User Story:
As an active student user,
I want a shareable graphical summary card of my monthly progress (total grams of protein consumed, money saved, consistency streak),
So that I can post it on Instagram or WhatsApp stories.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the `#/wrapped` view
- WHEN the monthly recap generates
- THEN a visually striking card displays total protein consumed (kg), campus ranking percentile, money saved vs. whey protein, and a 'Share to Story' download button.

Summary: US-20: Hostel Mess Menu OCR & Plate Vision Helper
Description:
User Story:
As a hosteler eating at a campus mess,
I want to upload a photo of the weekly mess noticeboard menu,
So that the AI can highlight which dishes have the highest protein content.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the `#/optimizer` or `#/assistant` tool
- WHEN a student uploads an image of a mess menu schedule
- THEN POST /api/genz/vision-menu parses the meal text, identifies protein-rich options (Dal, Rajma, Chole, Dahi, Paneer day), and advises supplemental staples to bridge the protein gap.
